title: 远程办公的讨论
text:
在我家里，我每天通过电脑工作。现在很多人支持这种方式，因为不用在路上浪费时间。不管天气如何，我们都能准时开始任务。这样可以增加个人自由，减轻生活压力。
然而，这种模式也有缺点。长期在家会导致社交减少，人容易感到孤独。面对面交流比发邮件更有效率。不管工作量多少，缺乏同事的鼓励都会影响心情。
此外，家里的环境可能干扰注意力。很难把生活和职业完全分开。如果不能管理好时间，休息时间会被占用。
我认为最好的办法是结合两者。每周去公司几天，其余时间居家。这样既能保持联系，又能享受方便。每个人应该根据自身情况选择最合适的方案。

questions.prompt: According to the text, what is one drawback of long-term remote work?
options: It can lead to reduced social contact and loneliness

What solution does the narrator suggest at the end of the text?
options: Combining office days and remote work days each week

questions.prompt: According to the text, what can happen if someone doesn't manage their time well while working from home?
options: Rest time gets taken over by work
They will need to hire a colleague

questions.prompt: Besides increasing personal freedom, what else does the text say remote work reduces?

patterns.title: 把 disposal
patterns.explanation: Moves the object in front of the verb to emphasise what was done to it. Often translated as "take X and …" — "I took the book and read it."

patterns.title: 被 passive
patterns.explanation: Marks the passive voice: the subject is acted upon. 被 introduces the agent (optional) and is followed by the verb.
